verses.text: A psalm by David. I’ll sing about faithful love and justice. LORD, you’re the one I’ll praise.
I’ll pay attention to how I live so I can walk with integrity. When will you come to me? Even in my own house, I’ll live with a heart that’s right.
I won’t set anything vile in front of my eyes. I hate what faithless people do. I won’t let any of it stick to me.
I’ll keep a twisted heart far from me. I’ll have nothing to do with evil.
If someone secretly runs down their neighbor, I’ll silence them. I won’t put up with people who look down on others and think too highly of themselves.
I’ll look for faithful people in the land and bring them to live with me. Those who walk with integrity will serve me.
Anyone who makes a habit of deceiving people won’t live under my roof. Liars won’t get to stay in my presence.
Morning after morning I’ll bring down every wicked person in the land, cutting off everyone who does evil from the LORD’s city.
